name: The Resonant Crystal Harp Cavern
description: A subterranean cathedral where stalactites and stalagmites are perfectly tuned crystal harps. Groundwater dripping plays eternal symphonies, each chamber a different key. Bioluminescent moss glows in rhythm with the music.
prompt: Massive limestone cavern transformed into a natural concert hall. Stalactites and stalagmites are perfectly formed crystal harps -- transparent calcite strings of varying lengths bridge between ceiling and floor formations. Water droplets fall in precise rhythmic patterns, striking crystal strings to produce pure tones. Each chamber resonates in a different musical key (marked by color-coded bioluminescent moss: C-major chamber glows warm amber, D-minor cool blue, etc.). Sound visualized as glowing particles rising from impact points. Underground pool reflects crystal forest. Ethereal, sacred atmosphere. Architectural photography style, subterranean lighting.
caption: The earth sings in mineral voices. 💎🎶 Every drop a note. Every chamber a key. The moss pulses with the rhythm of water on crystal. Listen long enough and you'll hear the planet's heartbeat.
